---
title: 'Appendix G — Alternative aggregation rules'
format: html
---

A quarter is treated if the program was active in

- one-month rule: at least one of its three months
- majority rule: at least two of its three months
- all-months rule: all three months

```{r}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, arrow, here, polars, DIDmultiplegtDYN)

data_one <- read_parquet(here("data", "data_quarterly.parquet"))
data_majority <- read_parquet(here("data", "data_quarterly_majority.parquet"))
data_all_months <- read_parquet(here("data", "data_quarterly_all_months.parquet"))
```

## One-month rule

### k = 1

```{r}
one_k1 <- did_multiplegt_dyn(
  df        = data_one,
  outcome   = "n_installations_per_1000",
  group     = "id",
  time      = "time",
  treatment = "treatment",
  effects   = 1,
  placebo   = 1
)
print(one_k1)
```
